orgEngineTab.intro: Choose which query engine this organization runs on. The deployment runs {{engine}}; this organization can share it, take a dedicated one, or run an engine of its own.
orgEngineTab.modeShared: Shared — the pooled engine Provisa operates
orgEngineTab.modeSharedHelp: The default. Your queries run on the multi-tenant coordinator, isolated by catalog and role.
orgEngineTab.modeIsolated: Isolated — a dedicated engine Provisa operates for this organization
orgEngineTab.modeIsolatedHelp: A coordinator reserved for this organization alone. No other tenant's work shares its resources.
orgEngineTab.modeIsolatedUnavailable: This deployment cannot provision a dedicated coordinator, so an isolated engine is not available here.
orgEngineTab.modeExternalHelp: Point Provisa at an engine you run — any supported kind, not only the deployment's {{engine}}. Planning and governance stay in Provisa; execution lands on your cluster.
orgEngineTab.kindHelp: Which engine this organization runs. It does not have to match the deployment's — an organization can run on its own Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse or Trino.
orgEngineTab.urlHelp: The connection URL for this engine, including its credentials.
orgEngineTab.urlStored: A URL is stored. Leave blank to keep it; enter a new one to replace it.
orgEngineTab.applyNote: Saving rebuilds this organization's runtime immediately. Queries in flight finish on the previous engine.
